effective_date_basis: Effective date of the revoking instrument per tract; or a current basis through 2026-10-14.
ending_pattern: Land withdrawal for water-power or reservoir purposes (the type includes reservoir site reserves made under the same 1910 withdrawal act, as in the exemplar; no numbered Power Site Reserve order that creates a reserve has a held text yet): continues until revoked, modified or vacated by a later order or Public Land Order. Under Federal Power Act s.24 (16 U.S.C. 818), lands reserved for power purposes may be opened to entry only on a Federal Power Commission determination, with a reserved right of re-entry; the 'until otherwise directed by the Commission or by Congress' wording of s.24 applies to lands in a filed project application. Restoration orders diminish a reserve.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Valid existing rights; licences under the Federal Power Act. A restoration under FPA s.24 may reserve a right of re-entry for power purposes (a residual). FLPMA (Pub. L. 94-579, Oct. 21, 1976) s.704(a) repealed the Pickett Act and implied withdrawal authority prospectively; s.701 saves existing withdrawals until modified under FLPMA or other law (IBLA, Grant L. Hacking, 1980). This is a continuity point, never an end; the s.204(l) review of withdrawals is a review lead, not an end.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
Lands reserved by a filed project application under FPA s.24, with no executive order.
Restoration subject to FPA s.24 conditions (Commission determination, reserved right of re-entry).
The order itself is a restoration (it ends part of another order rather than creating a reserve).
